published_implementation.note: The public ten-epoch proof and implementation are preserved at the same repository revision used by the canonical assessment. The run-specific locked fitness benchmark itself is operator-approved and not a shared cross-system benchmark family.

observations.benchmark: KADATH operator-approved run-specific locked fitness benchmark
observations.benchmark_scope: one operator-approved run-specific locked fitness benchmark
observations.protocol_boundary: The non-evolving kernel, approved benchmark and objective hashes, grading/evidence pipeline, scoring formulas, selection controls and lineage machinery remain outside the evolvable organism genome. Organism frameworks mutate only after grading; accepted changed genomes are activated for later epochs under the same locked fitness definition.
observations.metric_note: The first-party README reports a ten-epoch upward shift in the leading cohort. Each epoch point may represent a different top-performing agent, so these metrics describe population-level evolutionary improvement rather than one individual trajectory.
observations.comparability_limitation: The fitness benchmark is generated from the user goal and explicitly approved and locked per run. The published proof does not expose enough run metadata to reconstruct a common model/goal/population/configuration cell with A-Evolve or another canonical S4 system. Preserve this as a heterogeneous within-system observation, not a matched cross-harness score.
observations.non_claim: This longitudinal within-system result is not a matched cross-harness score and does not determine canonical VSM autonomy states.
